title: Benchmark LoCoMo/LongMemEval "our way": pre-learn conversations into the DAG at write time, then answer their QA probes over the DAG edge-read path — not retrieval-time RAG
summary:
Resolves the soundness concern that LoCoMo/LongMemEval are retrieval-time-recall benchmarks while Zonoid is write-time RAG materialized into the DAG (extends note-mqgu5ovs60x). The user rejected both "beat the bar with retrieval-time RAG" and "benchmark only the search_knowledge fallback." Chosen METHODOLOGY ("our way"):

(1) PRE-LEARN — ingest each benchmark conversation/session into the graph as nodes at WRITE time, running Zonoid's real materialization (autowire embed+cosine+cross-encoder + LLM edge-judge) so relevant memory freezes as context_deps edges, exactly as a normal task would.
(2) PROBE OVER DAG — answer the benchmark's own QA probes using Zonoid's READ path (DAG edge traversal / get_dependency_summaries), NOT by bolting retrieval-time embed+cosine+rerank on top. Candidate mechanism: treat each QA probe as a node and let the same write-time edge materialization decide its context_deps (pre-retrieval), then answer from the inherited edges — so the score measures whether write-time-materialized context routing delivers the right memory to answer the probe. (Exact mechanism to be pinned down in design.)
(3) SCORE vs the benchmark's gold answers; report next to the competitor bar (Mem0 LoCoMo 92.5 / LongMemEval 94.4; Zep 91.6 / 94.8). Arms: our-way DAG-read primary; optionally a search_knowledge retrieval-time arm + a cold/no-memory arm for contrast.

DELIVERABLE NOW: set up the harness (adapter + probe runner + scoring + report), mirroring the existing SWE-Bench-CL Zonoid memory adapter (task 9195fb5e-f196-497d-962f-69616733d2e9/19). PUBLIC FRAMING: present LoCoMo/LongMemEval as a CONTRAST axis (retrieval-time recall) and report Zonoid's number as "their test, our architecture" — not a head-to-head concession that recall is the metric. Holding the register attempt (commit 874a547, task .../1) UNMERGED so the sound framing + the our-way number land together via the harness feature, rather than publishing the head-to-head "competitor bar" framing first.
